versions.version: Breaking: targets .NET 10 (.NET 8 is no longer supported); System.Text.Encoding.CodePages dependency removed. Image transparency fixes (PNG alpha/color detection), validated color masks, reusable stencil masks, new HpdfImage.SetSoftMask. PDF version is raised automatically for transparency (1.4). Color masks work on gray images; a PNG is read from the current stream position. AcroForms: checkboxes, radio buttons and signature fields draw their own frame (colors from SetAppearanceCharacteristics), the appearance state always follows the field value, /SigFlags is set for signature fields. Breaking: IElementAppearance has new members Caption and DrawFrame.
Feature: Identity-H Unicode support in HpdfCIDFont. The skill for nuget-skills added.
Fully C# version of Haru PDF library.
